How do I use it properly the very first time?
Using your new jewellery for the first time is so exciting! Here’s how to make the most of it:
Unbox with Care: Your piece will arrive in a branded box or envelope. If it’s a gift, you can upgrade to a luxury gift box for an extra special touch.
Wear It Right: If it’s a necklace or bracelet, adjust the clasp to fit comfortably. For pendants, pair them with a chain you love.
Daily Care: Our pieces are durable, but avoid harsh chemicals or prolonged water exposure unless it’s one of our water-resistant stainless steel items.
Style It: Mix and match with your wardrobe or layer with other pieces for a chic look.
Enjoy your first piece—it’s going to look amazing on you! Let me know if you need more tips. 🧡
